finding.title: The buffer size is set to 258 bytes, which is larger than the typical buffer size for network communication.
The server reads input from the user and sends it back to the client without any validation or sanitization.
The server does not handle errors gracefully, which can lead to unexpected behavior or security vulnerabilities.
The server does not validate the input received from the client, which can lead to unexpected behavior or security vulnerabilities.

scan_orig.message: Statically-sized arrays can be improperly restricted, leading to potential overflows or other issues (CWE-119!/CWE-120).
Does not handle strings that are not \0-terminated; if given one it may perform an over-read (it could cause a crash if unprotected) (CWE-126).
